# Lib.io.freed

## Operators

- [**FreeDInput**](FreeDInput.md) — Receives camera tracking data over UDP using the FreeD protocol. This is essential for virtual production, augmented reality, and broadcasting, allowing real-time integration with systems like Unreal Engine, Vizrt, or Aximmetry.
- [**FreeDOutput**](FreeDOutput.md) — Sends camera tracking data over UDP using the FreeD protocol. This is essential for virtual production, augmented reality, and broadcasting, allowing real-time integration with systems like Unreal Engine, Vizrt, or Aximmetry.
